intro: A fresh look at the next fortnight: exploratory sound, phone-free listening, a free film-and-conversation evening, and independent performances worth stepping outside for. This owner-only staging edition uses three real artist photographs.
disclaimer: Organizer pages reviewed 16 November. Prices and ticket links are reported as listed; remaining seats are not guaranteed. This private test edition is not a subscriber release.
